question: Which students took the course Quantum Basket Weaving?

changes.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT students.id, students.name
FROM students
JOIN enrollments ON students.id = enrollments.student_id
JOIN course_offerings ON enrollments.offering_id = course_offerings.id
JOIN courses ON course_offerings.course_id = courses.id
WHERE courses.title = 'Quantum Basket Weaving';
